terms.gloss: seize eagerly; make for (a place); take in hand, undertake
evidence: Cic. ND 2.115: omnēs mundī partēs undique medium locum capessentēs nītuntur aequāliter (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: omnēs mundī partēs undique medium locum capessentēs nītuntur aequāliter
phrases.english: all parts of the world press equally from every side, making for the centre
